title: Assistant Accountant (Part-Time, 3 Days per Week)
description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly organised Assistant Accountant to join our client on a part-time basis, working 3 days per week. You will need to be flexible with your availability to meet the needs of the business. This role will initially be based on-site during the probationary period, providing the opportunity to become fully integrated within the business. Upon successful completion of probation, the position can become fully remote. Due to the location of the office, candidates will require their own transport. A competitive salary is offered on a pro rata basis for a 3-day working week.

As the Assistant Accountant, your duties will include:
- Receiving and processing receipts for payment.
- Raising sales invoices and managing client payment timescales, working directly with clients and project managers where required.
- Processing payroll and managing PAYE and National Insurance payments.
- Running debtor and creditor statements to monitor income and expenditure.
- Producing profit and loss reports and linking time-booking data to project costs for key projects.
- Managing ledgers and assisting with account auditing activities.
- Estimating revenues and expenditures.
- Completing statutory and legislative requirements, including PAYE, VAT submissions, and pension auto-enrolment administration.
- Preparing periodic financial reports for management.
- Providing administrative support to the statutory accountant and consultants, including invoice generation.
- Performing daily accounts administration and data entry tasks.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and monitoring financial transactions.
- Acting as the point of contact for staff pensions, including private and auto-enrolment schemes.

About You

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous experience within a similar standalone accounts controller role.
- Strong working knowledge of Xero.
- Experience processing payroll and managing VAT, PAYE, and pension administration.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Strong numerical and analytical skills.
- Effective problem-solving abilities.
- Excellent communication skills, including confidence using email and Microsoft Teams.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing business needs.
- A trustworthy, reliable, and professional approach.

If you are an experienced Assistant Accountant looking for a flexible part-time opportunity where you can make a real impact within a growing business, we would love to hear from you.

The HR Administrator supports the People Team (3 people) by effectively managing administration and coordination across the employee lifecycle, including responsibility for monthly payroll processing (training provided if required).

The position requires flexibility, good administration skills and an enthusiastic and dynamic approach to delivery of a wide variety of tasks.

HR Administrator Benefits and Package:
- 09:00 - 17:30 (Monday to Friday)
- Free On Site Parking
- 24 Days Annual Leave (increase by 1 day per year of service up to additional 4) + Bank Holidays
- Birthday Leave
- Generous Company Pension Scheme.
- Private Healthcare
- Life insurance
- Cycle to work
- Nursery Salary Sacrifice Schemes.

HR Administrator Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities:
- Manage administration for new starters, onboarding, contract changes, and leavers
- Maintain accurate employee records and documentation on
- Ensure timely and accurate processing of People-related updates
- Support issuing of ID documentation
- Prepare and process monthly payroll inputs for UK and Malta employees
- Ensure accuracy of salary data, benefits, and deductions
- Liaise with payroll providers and internal stakeholders
- Support payroll reporting and reconciliation
- Ensure compliance with payroll regulations and company policies
- Compliance with payroll regulations and reporting requirements

- Coordinate recruitment activities including job postings and interview scheduling

- Arrange simulator assessments, travel, and accommodation

- Assist with minute-taking during interviews and formal meetings
- Support internal communication and People initiatives

- Promote company values across all activities
- Support compliance with People policies and procedures
- Ensure all activities align with company standards and legal requirements
- Maintain a professional and confidential approach to all People matters

HR Administrator Qualities:
- Strong written and spoken English
- High attention to detail and numerical accuracy
- Strong IT skills (Microsoft Office)
- Ability to work effectively with all levels of staff
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Experience handling confidential information
- Good communication and interpersonal skills
- Flexible and proactive approach
- Payroll administration experience (UK and/or Malta), desirable
- Recruitment support experience, desirable

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Our client, an established, forward thinking firm of Chartered Accountants are seeking a diligent and detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join their expanding team in Fareham, Hampshire.

The role will managing your own mixed portfolio of clients, dealing with their bookkeeping, preparing accounts, invoicing and maintaining financial records.

Duties include:-
- Bookkeeping for clients on a monthly/quarterly basis
- Preparation of VAT returns
- Management accounts and annual accounts
- Provide clients with training and support on the use of Xero, Sage and QuickBooks

You will ideally have at least 2 years UK practice experience with a client facing background and hold a professional bookkeeping qualification such as AAT or studying towards this.

A strong working knowledge of accounting software such as Xero, Sage and QuickBooks would also be an advantage.

This is a great opportunity with good prospects and benefits including flexible working environment and onsite parking.

title: Insolvency Administrator
description:
Company Description

About FRP

FRP is a leading national business advisory firm based in the UK. With over 900 team members, including more than 100 partners, we specialise in Corporate Finance, Debt Advisory, Forensic Services, Financial Advisory, Restructuring Advisory and Real Estate Advisory. Operating from 35 offices across the UK, Isle of Man and Cyprus, we are dedicated to helping clients navigate complex and difficult situations to create, preserve, and recover value.

Our approach is known for being honest, clear, and considered. We provide strategic solutions that cater to a broad range of businesses, from multinational organisations to small enterprises. Our commitment is to deliver expert advice and support, ensuring our clients can make informed decisions and achieve their goals.

Job Description

Role overview

FRP Advisory is seeking a highly skilled and enthusiastic Administrator to join our restructuring department. The candidate will have a background in restructuring advisory and insolvency, including administrations and liquidations. This role involves the development and execution of asset recovery strategies in insolvency cases, coordinating with various stakeholders, and ensuring the smooth progression of the team's caseload.

Key Responsibilities include
- Under the direct supervision of more senior members of the team, to assist with the pro-active administration of insolvency cases, comprising ADMs, CVLs and CVAs, in accordance with specific timescales
- Production of good quality reports and letters
- Completion of all tasks and formalities in accordance with statutory deadlines and internal protocols
- Maintaining an effective diary system in this respect
- Maximising asset realisations and ensuring recoveries are pursued in a pro-active and cost-effective way
- Monitoring, maintenance and up-dating of check lists on a weekly basis
- Taking personal responsibility to ensure that any tasks delegated by more senior staff are completed in a timely and professional manner
- Enhance technical knowledge and to keep abreast of industry developments/new case law

Qualifications
- Experience in an insolvency role
- Strong organisational and multitasking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team
- High level of attention to detail and accuracy

Additional Information

Our Values
- Straightforward: We provide clear, no-nonsense advice
- Confident: Our guidance is backed by expertise and evidence
- Pragmatic: We focus on practical solutions and tangible outcomes
- Real: We are professional yet approachable, understanding the challenges our clients face

Our Commitment to You and the Environment

At FRP Advisory Group, sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on building and maintaining meaningful, long-term relationships with all our stakeholders - including our employees, clients, and local communities - while also reducing our impact on the natural environment.

We are always striving to improve in all areas - whether it's our people, our clients, our planet or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and diverse culture for our people. We maintain an Equal Opportunities Policy, ensuring that recruitment and employment decisions are based solely on the skills and experience required for our professional services - regardless of ethnicity, race, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe every individual should have the opportunity to thrive.

Our learning and development programmes enable us to invest in growing our employees' careers. We aim to empower our team members to each achieve their potential.

We are committed to growing long-term relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients' sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We are emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

title: Service Receptionist
description:
The Role:

Silcom Recruitment are recruiting on behalf of a well-established and highly regarded automotive accident repair centre based in the Petersfield area. Our client is seeking a professional and customer-focused Service Receptionist to join their busy Bodyshop team.

Operating from an established and highly regarded repair centre, the business provides a comprehensive range of vehicle accident and body repair services, including collision repairs, dent removal, paint and scratch repairs, vehicle diagnostics and associated repair work.

This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated and organised Service Receptionist to join a successful automotive business and become an integral part of a busy Bodyshop operation.

Working closely with customers, technicians, estimators and the wider Bodyshop team, you will be responsible for providing a welcoming and professional first point of contact while helping to ensure customers receive a smooth and well-communicated experience throughout their vehicle's repair journey.

Responsibilities of a Service Receptionist:

Act as the first point of contact for customers visiting or contacting the Bodyshop.

Welcome customers professionally and establish the nature of their enquiry or vehicle repair requirements.

Handle incoming telephone calls, emails and customer enquiries efficiently and professionally.

Book customer vehicles into the Bodyshop and coordinate appointments for vehicle assessments, repairs and collections.

Keep customers regularly informed regarding the progress of their vehicle repairs.

Liaise closely with estimators, technicians and Bodyshop colleagues to obtain repair updates and communicate these clearly to customers.

Coordinate vehicle drop-offs and collections, ensuring all relevant paperwork and information is completed accurately.

Assist with the organisation and administration of courtesy vehicles where required.

Communicate with insurance companies, accident management companies and other third parties when necessary.

Ensure customer and vehicle records are maintained accurately and kept up to date throughout the repair process.

Handle customer queries and concerns professionally, escalating matters to the appropriate colleague when required.

Provide customers with clear information regarding repair timescales and manage expectations throughout the process.

Support the preparation and processing of repair documentation, invoices and other administrative paperwork.

Ensure the reception and customer-facing areas are maintained to a professional standard.

Build and maintain positive working relationships with customers, technicians, estimators and colleagues across the business.

Deliver a consistently high standard of customer service from the initial enquiry through to the customer's vehicle collection.

Support the wider Bodyshop team in achieving customer satisfaction, operational and departmental targets.

The Package:

Salary: Up to £35,000 Basic

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am - 17:30pm - 1 in 2 Saturday mornings 08:00am-12:00pm.

Don't worry if your CV isn't up to date - get in touch, and we can help with the rest

title: Legal Assistant - Commercial Property
company: Harwood Recruitment Solutions Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
I'm currently recruiting for a Legal Assistant to join the Commercial Property team within a well established Law firm in Portsmouth. This is a great opportunity to become part of an experienced team, working closely with the Fee Earners and getting involved in a varied range of commercial property matters. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include opening new files, carrying out compliance checks, preparing correspondence and legal documents, speaking with clients and assisting with post-completion work.

I'm looking for someone with previous office or administration experience who enjoys working with others and providing a high level of client care. Experience in a law firm, conveyancing or commercial property would be ideal, but not essential. If you're organised, have a keen eye for detail and are looking for a role where you can learn, develop and become a valued part of the team, I'd love to hear from you.

Day to day duties will include -
- Open new files, deal with all compliance requirements and client care due diligence in the process, and subsequently undertake such work on the file as may be directed by the Fee Earner such as carrying out searches and legal research.
- Accurately draft letters and correspondence, type up amendments, prepare initial draft of legal documents and prepare engrossments. All typing to be spell checked and proof read prior to passing to the Fee Earner.
- Ensure any post is ready in time for Reception to arrange for this to be franked and placed in the post bag.
- Fully utilise the Case Management system, file documents and all correspondence and generally keep the system up to date and in an organised manner. The paper file is to be kept to a similar standard.
- Filing should be undertaken at the request of your Fee Earner.
- Answer the telephone promptly in a professional manner, being polite and helpful at all times. The aim to assist with calls of a general nature on your Fee Earner's files, giving updates on matters where necessary, or taking messages where this is not possible.
- Attend clients on behalf of your Fee Earner in reception and on the telephone for routine matters such as making appointments/collecting documents/paying bills etc or as directed by the Fee Earner.
- Assist your Fee Earner with the preparation of bills and completion statements and ensure that they have been sent to the appropriate external and internal parties.
- Deal with post-completion elements on the files including preparing and submitting Land Registry applications as well as Stamp Duty Land Tax forms and deal with any subsequent requisitions/enquiries.

This is a full time, office based role - working 9am - 5pm, Monday to Friday, offering competitive salary, excellent benefits and full training and support - please apply today!
